Owned approved Hero C from supplied sources, soft dimensional cartoon fantasy shading, fixed elevated orthographic isometric view. Same dark tied hair/short beard/blue tunic and scarf/cream sleeves/olive trousers/brown backpack gloves boots. EVERY pose faces TOWARD CAMERA, FRONT VIEW, same orientation all six, constant body scale and planted foot baseline, generous transparent gutters and room below soles. Sequence0 ready;1 backswing;2 raised windup;3 CONTACT IN FRONT OF HERO TOWARD CAMERA;4 short recoil;5 ready recovery. CRITICAL phase3/4: BOTH hands hold a single tool extending FORWARD FROM HERO TOWARD CAMERA into foreground, head centered horizontally x=0 plus/minus .12 relative to body, NOT FAR RIGHT OR LEFT. Contact head is BELOW soles on screen by .20-.30 world units, standing body height1.15, as it hits an imaginary target directly in front of feet toward viewer. Full shaft, both gripping hands and metal head physically connected; believable forearms/shoulder action, do not stretch body. NO target drawn. Not striking his own feet. Plenty of clear space below soles for full tool head. All anatomy/tool tips fully inside each cell; never crop. No scenery, ground, ground-shadow plane, labels, UI, text, grid, VFX, extra tools or checkerboard paint. Landscape atlas. Tool is the existing wooden-handled IRON AXE, two handed chopping toward a trunk in foreground, centered contact in front of feet. Preserve same iron axe blade shape as reference.

import_contract: Original PNG bytes retained. Unity-native sprite rects, one PPU per mineral size, fixed foot registration, native work-geometry import and directional mirroring; no external image postprocessing.
size_correction: Small stone/ore preserve original visible world width. Medium and large scaled proportionally by native pixels-per-unit; source prompt size examples do not override actual project art data.
